001: Ivan, have you decided what you're going to order yet?
Not yet. What are you getting?
I want a cappuccino and, probably, a cheesecake.
Sounds tasty. Then I'll get a latte and a croissant.
Great, let's go up to the counter together.
002: Good afternoon! Can I get a large americano?
Of course. Anything else for you?
The eclair will be two hundred rubles. Anything for dessert?
Then that'll be three hundred fifty rubles.
003: Olga, have you ordered anything yet?
Yes, I got tea with bergamot. What about you?
I'm thinking of getting a hot chocolate.
That's a good choice, it's cold today.
Don't you want to try their new dessert?
I would try it, but I'm already full.
004: Excuse me, do you have lactose-free milk?
Yes, of course. Would it work for a cappuccino?
Yes, perfect. And can I get less syrup?
No problem. What syrup would you like?
Caramel, but just a tiny bit.
Okay, I'll make it with half a portion.
005: Sergey, are you going to eat anything?
Yes, I'll get the chicken sandwich. What about you?
I just want a salad and a glass of orange juice.
Don't you want anything stronger? Maybe some coffee?
No, I won't be able to sleep as it is.
Well, suit yourself. I'm still getting a double espresso.
006: Excuse me, miss, can I have a minute?
I ordered a cappuccino, but I was brought a latte.
Oh, I'm so sorry, I'll fix that right away.
Thank you so much. And also, could I get some napkins?
Of course, I'll bring everything together.
007: Maria, have you tried their signature drink yet?
It's coffee with honey and cinnamon. Very tasty.
Really? Then I'll order it too.
I hope so. Is it very sweet?
008: Do you have a table for two by the window?
Yes, let me check. One moment.
Unfortunately, the one by the window is taken. But there's a table in the corner.
That's fine, that one will work.
Then come on in, I'll bring the menu.
009: Are you going to order dessert?
Yes, I want to try their tiramisu.
And I'll get the carrot cake.
Great choice. Did you order coffee yet?
010: Can I get one more glass of water, please?
Of course, I'll bring it right away.
And can I have the check, please.
Yes, one second. Did you enjoy everything?
Thank you! Come see us again.
